content.title: Airline CEOs meet with VP Vance to discuss shutdown impacts
content.description:
As the US government shutdown has continued for nearly a month, major airline executives met with Vice President JD Vance at the White House on Thursday to communicate how the shutdown could impact the industry if it drags on further.

Yahoo Finance senior reporter Pras Subramanian comes on Market Domination to discuss the roundtable event, which included United Airlines (UAL) CEO Scott Kirby, American Airlines (AAL) CEO Robert Isom, and several union leaders.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: Airlines cutting fare is 'putting pressure' on low-cost carriers
content.description:
United Airlines (UAL) saw revenue from its premium business grow by 6% in the operator's third quarter, similar to Delta Air Lines' (DAL) own earnings boost it saw in thanks to premium travel bookings.

Bloomberg Intelligence senior aerospace defense and airlines industry analyst George Ferguson comes on Market Catalysts to discuss how larger airlines are cutting airfare prices to better compete with low-cost carriers.

Also catch George Ferguson explain why he believes United may have overloaded its capacity this past quarter.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
